metas.name: ★ 8.9 · 2016 · O.J.: Made in America
metas.description: A chronicle of the rise and fall of O.J. Simpson, whose high-profile murder trial exposed the extent of American racial tensions, revealing a fractured and divided nation.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2017 · The Dawn Wall
metas.description: In an unbelievable story of perseverance, free climber Tommy Caldwell and climbing partner Kevin Jorgeson attempt to scale the impossible 3000ft Dawn Wall of El Capitan.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2018 · Müslüm
metas.description: A biopic about turkish vocal artist Müslüm Gürses, drama, childhood, his life.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2015 · Manjhi: The Mountain Man
metas.description: Using only a hammer and a chisel, a man spends twenty-two years carving a road through a treacherous mountain.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2019 · Diego Maradona
metas.description: Constructed from over 500 hours of never-before-seen footage, this documentary centers on the career of celebrated football player Diego Maradona, who played for S.S.C. Napoli in the 1980s.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2018 · Mahanati
metas.description: Biography of Savitri, an actress from South India movie industry, who ruled the industry for two decades during 50s and 60s.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2019 · Pocket Hercules: Naim Süleymanoglu
metas.description: The biography of Turkish weightlifter and Olympic champion Naim Suleymanoglu.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2018 · RBG
metas.description: The exceptional life and career of U.S. Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg, who has developed a breathtaking legal legacy while becoming an unexpected pop culture icon.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2015 · What Happened, Miss Simone?
metas.description: A documentary about the life and legend Nina Simone, an American singer, pianist, and civil rights activist labeled the "High Priestess of Soul."

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2018 · Champion
metas.description: A true love and success story from the 1990s Turkey, revolving around a jockey (Halis Karatas), a horse (Bold Pilot) and the daughter of the horse's owner who is at the same time the voluntary caretaker of the horse.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2015 · Holding the Man
metas.description: Tim and John fell in love at their all-boys high school. Their romance endured for 15 years to laugh in the face of everything life threw at it - the separations, the discrimination, the temptations, the jealousies and the losses.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2016 · Oasis: Supersonic
metas.description: Oasis's breakthrough years documented into a detailed depiction of the band from the formation in Manchester in the early 1990s leading up to the legendary performance at Knebworth Festival.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2019 · For Sama
metas.description: An intimate and epic journey into a young woman's experience of war during the revolution in Aleppo, Syria.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2018 · A Twelve-Year Night
metas.description: 1973. Uruguay is governed by a military dictatorship. One autumn night, three Tupamaro prisoners are taken from their jail cells in a secret military operation. The order is precise: "As we can't kill them, let's drive them mad."

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2018 · Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
metas.description: An intimate look into the life and work of the revered master comedian and actor, Robin Williams.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2015 · Requiem for the American Dream
metas.description: Renowned academic and author Noam Chomsky elucidates 10 principles of concentration of wealth and power that have led to unprecedented inequality and the hollowing out of the American middle class.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2017 · Spielberg
metas.description: A documentary on Steven Spielberg, filmmaker. Includes interviews with relatives, film critics, peers and people who have worked with him.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2018 · McQueen
metas.description: The life and career of fashion designer Lee Alexander McQueen: from his start as a tailor, to launching and overseeing his eponymous line and his untimely death.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2015 · Aligarh
metas.description: A gay, linguistic professor living in a small orthodox city must deal with the aftermath of a sting operation that puts his sexual orientation in front of the entire nation.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2019 · Rolling Thunder Revue: A Bob Dylan Story by Martin Scorsese
metas.description: In an alchemic mix of fact and fantasy, Martin Scorsese looks back at Bob Dylan's 1975 Rolling Thunder Revue tour and a country ripe for reinvention.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2015 · Listen to Me Marlon
metas.description: A documentary that utilizes hundreds of hours of audio that Marlon Brando recorded over the course of his life to tell the screen legend's story.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2015 · The Fear of 13
metas.description: A convicted murderer who has spent 23 years on Death Row tells his story.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2015 · Ennu Ninte Moideen
metas.description: Based on the real-life love story of Moideen and Kanchanamala, which happened in the 1960s in the backdrop of Calicut.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2016 · 100 Meters

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2017 · Avicii: True Stories
metas.description: Focuses on the incredible rise, fall and rebirth of one of the worlds most successful electronic music artists of all time, Avicii.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2018 · Andre the Giant
metas.description: A look at the life and career of professional wrestler André Roussimoff, who gained notoriety in the 1980s as Andre the Giant.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2017 · Bingo: The King of the Mornings

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2017 · Jane
metas.description: The life and work of the renowned primatology scientist, Jane Goodall, especially on her research about chimpanzees.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2019 · Eftihia

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2019 · Saand Ki Aankh
metas.description: Both over the age of 60, Chandro Tomar and Prakashi Tomar inspire other women in India when they demonstrate their expert sharpshooting skills.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2018 · Quincy

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2019 · Held for Ransom
metas.description: The story of Danish photographer Daniel Rye, who was captured by ISIS in Syria in 2013 and held hostage for 398 days.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2016 · For the Love of Spock
metas.description: An examination of the enduring appeal of Leonard Nimoy and his portrayal of Spock in Star Trek (1966).
